notes: Omen on small screens (240×240 pump heads up to 5" screens): every style now has its own small-screen design built around its signature, instead of one shared list. Console: the porthole fills the screen, the time on a plate across it.…
Ledger and Hollow Readings keep the plain priority list.
On 3:2, 5:3 and 2:3 screens the next readings in priority order fill the side or bottom strip, each in its style's own look.
A long weather condition is cut to its first word where a small screen has room for one word.
